def process(meta):
    import pandas as pd
    df = meta.copy()
    # normalize common missing markers
    df['Histologic_type'] = df['Histologic_type'].astype(str)
    # keep serous histology
    ser = df[df['Histologic_type'].str.strip().str.lower().eq('serous')]
    # Age to numeric
    age = pd.to_numeric(ser['Age'], errors='coerce')
    # If participants repeated (multiple aliquots), average within participant first
    if 'Proteomics_Participant_ID' in ser.columns:
        tmp = pd.DataFrame({'Proteomics_Participant_ID': ser['Proteomics_Participant_ID'], 'Age': age})
        tmp = tmp.dropna(subset=['Proteomics_Participant_ID', 'Age'])
        age_per_participant = tmp.groupby('Proteomics_Participant_ID', as_index=False)['Age'].mean()
        out = pd.DataFrame({'average_age': [age_per_participant['Age'].mean()]})
    else:
        out = pd.DataFrame({'average_age': [age.mean()]})
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Filter meta to Histologic_type == 'Serous' (case/whitespace-insensitive), coerce Age to numeric, de-duplicate repeated samples by averaging Age per Proteomics_Participant_ID, then compute overall mean age
